macros.name: addsymboltotheme
macros.doc: To add a symbol symbol to theme theme, write \addsymboltotheme{theme}{symbol}.

macros.name: newsuite
macros.doc: To create a new suite suite based on theme theme, write \newsuite{theme}{suite}.

macros.name: newsuitetheme
macros.doc: To create a new suite theme called theme, write \newsuitetheme{theme}.
